items.author: Governor Joe Lombardo (@JosephMLombardo)
items.title: Gov. Lombardo joins governors urging Congress to act on permitting reform
items.summary: Nevada Gov. Joe Lombardo says he is joining governors from across the country in urging Congress to act on permitting reform. The post does not name S. 5653 or BAAJA.

quote.text: I'm joining Governors from across the country urging Congress to act on permitting reform – which means more reliable energy, stronger infrastructure, good-paying jobs, & lower costs for Nevadans.
quote.speaker: Governor Joe Lombardo

items.author: Governor Greg Gianforte (@GovGianforte)
items.title: Gov. Gianforte joins governors urging Congress to pass permitting reform
items.summary: Montana Gov. Greg Gianforte says he is joining governors from across the country in urging Congress to pass meaningful permitting reform. The post does not name S. 5653 or BAAJA.

quote.text: I’m joining governors from across the country in urging Congress to pass meaningful permitting reform.
quote.speaker: Governor Greg Gianforte

events.title: Governors Lombardo and Gianforte post joint call for Congress to act on permitting reform
events.summary: On Oct. 2, 2026, Nevada Gov. Joe Lombardo and Montana Gov. Greg Gianforte each posted on X that they had joined governors nationwide in urging Congress to act on permitting reform. Neither post names S. 5653, BAAJA, or a signer count, and neither links a letter text that was opened for this sweep.
events.significance: Governor-level public pressure for permitting action; the posts do not reference the Sept. 30 text.
